انغمسوا (form VII)
# اِنْغَمَسُوا (inḡamasū) /in.ɣa.ma.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# اِنْغَمِسُوا (inḡamisū) /in.ɣa.mi.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
